summary: Visit every gray-5 marker in row-major order. On the original input, choose its first adjacent green-3 cell using up/down/left/right priority, then for max(rows, columns) steps repeatedly choose the first original-input green neighbor other than the immediately previous cell. If the resulting trail has at least two cells, apply edits to the cumulative output: clear every trail cell and the original marker to orange 7, restore the final trail cell to green 3, and put gray 5 on the penultimate trail cell. Leave shorter/inactive markers, zeros, dormant green components, and unrelated cells unchanged.
